meta.title: Arm/hand protect mask v1 — the binding specification
meta.status: OWNER-APPROVED under D-128. Approval is bound to the sha256 below; a changed mask needs a new visual approval.

decisions.D-126: adopted the internal authoring fitting base as the next groundwork
decisions.D-127: decided the four open questions; §6(f) authorised building and verifying this mask
decisions.D-128: approves this exact file and corrects D-127 §3's raw strict-superset rule append-only

meta.neverSent: This mask is used only for local recomposition and acceptance checking. It is NEVER sent to the image API — D-127 §1 keeps every call maskless.
meta.notAuthorised: No fitting-base image call is authorised. No new one-shot claim may be created.

derivedBaseline.role: the OLD derived arm mask — evidence only, superseded; it contains the 1,054 false sleeve pixels

sleeveExclusions.role: the 1,054 documented false t-shirt sleeve / hem pixels that D-128 excludes

headProtectMask.role: the head protect zone, tracked so the zero-overlap check runs on a fresh clone

referenceArtwork.role: North Star v2 — the alpha the mask must stay inside; already tracked, not copied here

gates.areaNote: The interval is a sanity check against an empty mask and against a torso-swallowing mask. It is NOT visual evidence. Only the sha256 identifies the approved artwork.

transitionZone.what: visible skin and antialias immediately BELOW the old sleeve hem that is deliberately left unprotected
transitionZone.why: the mask starts 2-3 px under the black sleeve hem so the coming generation can join a newly bared upper arm to the preserved forearm
transitionZone.status: intentional under D-128 §4 — this is a transition zone, not a mask gap

provenance.method: hand-drawn polygons rasterised by a one-off script held outside both repositories; no colour classification, no flood fill, no contour detection, no morphology

exclusionEvidence.note: the 24 skin-nearest pixels are 1-2 px of antialias ON the hem edge itself; none is interior arm or hand skin

provenance.approvedBy: owner, visually, on the candidate-v2 review page and contact sheet
